sets.ocean: Beach and surf drawn on top of terrain/water and terrain/coast_land, transparent where the open sea and the land show; the number is a bit mask of the sides with land: 1 = north, 2 = east, 4 = south, 8 = west
sets.land: Terrain overlay drawn on terrain/land_base, self-contained within the tile; the number is a bit mask of the sides with the same terrain: 1 = north, 2 = east, 4 = south, 8 = west
sets.river: River on a land tile; the number is a bit mask of the sides it flows to: 1 = north, 2 = east, 4 = south, 8 = west
sets.road: Road or railroad from the centre of the tile to one side or corner, plus a middle piece; several are drawn on top of each other
sets.coast_land: The grass behind the beach of terrain/ocean/<mask> or terrain/ocean_corner/<corner>; the game uses it as a mask and paints the neighbouring land's terrain into it
